plan.title: Forward auction delivery location rejects free text

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Change the event type to Auction and configure the auction.
Choose the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Attempt to enter a location that is not a plant; the dropdown should offer no matching option and must not retain free text.
Assert that the invalid free-text delivery location was refused.
